descriptions.ADMIN: Full access: accounts, roles, organisation calendar, audit log.
descriptions.ADMIN_DELEGATED: Day-to-day administration, without permission governance or the audit log: a delegate cannot grant themselves permissions.
descriptions.PORTFOLIO_MANAGER: Portfolio health on one page, milestones at risk, workload by service.
descriptions.MANAGER: Approve leave knowing its impact, spot overloads, follow up on a staff member.
descriptions.MANAGER_PROJECT_FOCUS: Management centred on running projects; HR approval kept to a minimum.
descriptions.MANAGER_HR_FOCUS: Management centred on people: leave, remote work, attendance, skills.
descriptions.PROJECT_LEAD: Structure a project into milestones, know who is available, spot delays and dependencies.
descriptions.PROJECT_LEAD_JUNIOR: Project leadership without creating or archiving: steers existing projects, does not open new ones.
descriptions.TECHNICAL_LEAD: Technical leadership: tasks, dependencies, RACI, team skills. No project management.
descriptions.PROJECT_CONTRIBUTOR: Contribution to the projects one belongs to: own tasks, leave, remote work and time.
descriptions.PROJECT_CONTRIBUTOR_LIGHT: Reads and updates own tasks, without creating or deleting.
descriptions.FUNCTIONAL_REFERENT: Contribution extended to cross-cutting reading: understand the whole without acting on it.
descriptions.HR_OFFICER: Leave types and balances, bulk imports, oversight, skills catalogue.
descriptions.HR_OFFICER_LIGHT: Day-to-day HR without the reference data: no leave types, no balances, no account removal.
descriptions.THIRD_PARTY_MANAGER: Catalogue of external contributors and beneficiaries.
descriptions.CONTROLLER: Full cross-cutting read access and audit log. Changes nothing: that is its whole point.
descriptions.BUDGET_ANALYST: Declared time, budgets consumed, workload. Read and export.
descriptions.DATA_ANALYST: Reports and exports across the whole scope, without access to the audit log.
descriptions.IT_SUPPORT: Account support: reset a password, fix an organisational assignment. No role management: that is the line between support and administration.
descriptions.IT_INFRASTRUCTURE: Technical settings and organisation calendar; audit log read-only.
descriptions.OBSERVER_FULL: Read-only across the whole authorised scope. No writing, ever.
descriptions.OBSERVER_PROJECTS_ONLY: Read-only on projects. Sees nothing of leave or remote work.
descriptions.OBSERVER_HR_ONLY: Read-only on people and their availability. Sees nothing of project content.
descriptions.BASIC_USER: The bare essentials: own schedule, leave, remote work and time.
descriptions.EXTERNAL_PRESTATAIRE: External contractor: own tasks and time, nothing else. No leave, no remote work, no directory: not a member of staff.
descriptions.STAGIAIRE_ALTERNANT: Supervised contribution: own tasks, time and leave. Cannot create tasks outside a project.
